lib.off_board: Widget window, My widgets: status line for an item that is kept but not shown on any board (the opposite of lib.on_board). A short phrase.
lib.results: Widget window, My widgets: heading over the items that match the search box. A short phrase.
lib.updated_at: Widget window, My widgets: line on the selected item's card saying when its content last changed. {when} is a date and time already formatted.
lib.deleted_at: Widget window, My widgets: line on a recently deleted item's card saying when it was deleted. {when} is a date and time already formatted.
lib.records_tab: Widget window tab with the time record: time logged by stopwatches, pomodoros and timers, by day, week or month. One word.
rec.day: Records tab view switch: one day. One short word.
rec.week: Records tab view switch: one week. One short word.
rec.month: Records tab view switch: one month. One short word.
rec.prev: Tooltip of the ‹ button: the previous day, week or month.
rec.next: Tooltip of the › button: the next day, week or month.
rec.today: Button: jump back to the period with today in it. One word.
rec.by_task: Records tab side heading: time per to-do. 1 to 3 words.
rec.by_tag: Records tab side heading: time per tag. 1 to 3 words.
rec.none: Shown under a side heading when nothing is logged for it. Short phrase.
rec.empty_day: Shown on a day with no logged time. One sentence.
rec.hint: Note under the records: time from a running stopwatch or pomodoro appears once it is stopped or paused. One sentence.
rec.edit: Button on a logged entry: change its times, what it was for and its category. One word.
rec.del: Button on a logged entry: remove it. One word.
rec.del_confirm: The same button after one click, asking to click again to delete. 1 to 2 words, no question mark.
rec.save: Button: keep the edited entry. One word.
rec.cancel: Button: leave the edit without changes. One word.
rec.start: Screen-reader name of the start time field of an entry being edited.
rec.end: Screen-reader name of the end time field of an entry being edited.
rec.untitled: Stands in for a to-do with no title. Short, in brackets.
rec.save_failed: Toast when an edit or delete could not be written. Says it failed and to try again.
rec.deleted: Toast after a logged entry was deleted. One sentence.
